threads.body: The node-limit math in this inline comment is misleading: the query fetches `users(first: 20)` for *every* `reactionGroups` entry, so the worst-case node count scales with the number of reaction groups that have users (not just `threads * comments * 20`). This could confuse future adjustments if the query still approaches GitHub’s 500k GraphQL node limit.

replies.body:
Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/commit/a7f59a722bb50eb8d49d2bcda9b0fbb0525018a7.

Replaced the exact node-product math with a qualitative note that the users connection is nested under reactionGroups for each fetched review comment, so raising the cap multiplies the possible node count.
